# Unicode ↔ Preeti converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/unicode-preeti/

Convert Nepali Unicode text and legacy Preeti-encoded text. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Convert नेपाली text into Preeti encoding for a document, or recover Unicode from legacy text.

## Limits and checks

Preeti output needs a compatible font when pasted into a document. Legacy fonts and unusual conjuncts can require proofreading.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Lacspace — Preeti conversion library, version 1.1.0](https://developer.lacspace.com/packages/preeti)
